profile.headline: Applied AI / Full-Stack Engineer: production LLM systems, RAG, agents & MCP · Python/TypeScript · 85K-subscriber technical channel
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I build and ship production AI/LLM systems end-to-end — and the audiences behind them.

On the engineering side I integrate LLMs into live products and build the reusable building blocks around them: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search, tool-using agents, orchestration, evaluation/regression harnesses, and LLM Ops (telemetry, monitoring, cost/latency). I work in Python and TypeScript (Bun/Hono), self-host on Linux behind systemd + Cloudflare, and understand the transformer / multi-head-attention architecture beneath modern LLMs. Live proofs (all built by me):

• repo.ragflo.com/ask — RAG + eval harness + LLM Ops dashboard + a tool-using agent
• headlines.ragflo.com — a prompt-strategy bake-off (zero/few/multi/dynamic-few-shot) with scoring
• port.ragflo.com — portfolio

I also own and run an 85,000-subscriber technical YouTube channel, through which I've helped America's entrepreneurs raise tens of millions of dollars since the pandemic. Earlier I built the high-traffic platform that drew the 2012 Obama campaign's national Michelle Obama town hall (Forbes, Politico, NBC), drove SEO/technical strategy for Mundo Hispánico (Cloudflare-edge + Python at millions of monthly visitors), audited 2,000+ enterprise web properties at Nielsen, and grew Imperial Jets ~4× as CTO. Published contributor: Forbes, MediaShift, Adweek, The Huffington Post. U.S. Navy veteran.

positions.title: Founder / Software Engineer
positions.description:
Generate $1K to up to $10K a day for small companies generating leads through PPC ads, SEO, and social outreach.

Drove over 9 million video views and impressions to Adweek 
Super Bowl channel in two weeks of blogger and social media outreach.

Build and operate production AI/LLM systems: LLM integration, RAG/semantic search, tool-using agents on MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and Claude Code, evaluation harnesses, and LLM Ops — in Python and TypeScript (Bun/Hono), self-hosted on Linux (systemd) behind Cloudflare. Shipped live: RepoRadar (RAG/eval/LLM Ops/agent), Headline Lab, and Evolution. Also build/operate the full stack behind lead-generation platforms running up to $15,000/day.

Drove SEO and technical strategy for one of the largest U.S. Hispanic media platforms (millions of monthly visitors): re-architected tens of thousands of URLs and integrated Cloudflare edge automation with RankSense (a Python/NLP edge-SEO platform on Cloudflare Workers, later acquired by seoClarity), prioritizing fixes from per-article organic-traffic data analysis.

Build hundreds of backlinks to web properties in a number of hours through infographic marketing.

Teach thousands of entrepreneurs holding internet marketing workshops with the New York City Department of Small Business Services. 

Drove hundreds of thousands of unique visitors to Forbes publications.

positions.title: SEO Specialist
positions.description:
Drove over 1 million unique visitors to a microsite in less than one week for over $70,000 in ad revenue and a $50,000 corporate sponsorship of a print version.

Drove over 1.6 million unique visitors to a media mashup in less than one week for over $90,000 in ad revenue.

Orchestrated SEO strategy for over 2,000 Nielsens Media brands: Billboard.com, HollywoodReporter.com, Adweek.com, Mediaweek.com, Brandweek.com, PDNonline.com.

Conducted road shows to train editors and technology departments on what architectural, on-page, and off-page tasks need to be executed to rank for competitive keywords in their vertical.

Diagnosed architectural issues that had never been discovered by previous SEO teams.

Advised Technology Team on how to program their servers and sites to make it easier for these enterprise brands to be found on the search engines.

Work with the editorial team to develop features to which I have driven almost half a million page views from major social media channels.
